rationale: Because the Court is unanimous on a narrow Article III standing ground and the Chief Justice emphasized Ashwander-style restraint, Roberts is most likely to keep the opinion tight and jurisdictional. Barrett/Thomas/Gorsuch have elevated interest in clarifying the “likely, not speculative” Clapper/Lujan standard and may write separately to sharpen the redressability/traceability framework without reaching the Clean Air Act merits.
